text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To make her clearly aware of her efforts, 
the Trainer announces that they will push 
her to the absolute limit during this 
summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Catching Hishi Miracle trying to escape, 
they add extra training as punishment, 
willingly taking on the role of the bad 
guy.
